description:
**Job title: Network Platform Automation and Performance Engineer**

* Location: Hyderabad

This team, behind Sanofi’s Next Generation Network \& Security services and infrastructure that powers it, is looking for a self\-motivated and innovative thinking individual to raise the bar on Sanofi’s Network infrastructure while maintaining relevance in the fast moving and evolving network industry.

  

As a member of the team, you will be driving optimization, scalability, and maintaining the performance of network infrastructure that supports digital platforms. In this role, you will bridge traditional networking and modern platform/DevOps needs, ensuring our distributed applications, cloud services, and internal systems operate with ultra\-low latency, high resilience, and maximum efficiency.


You will also act as the technical subject matter expert for network data paths, traffic management, and performance diagnostics by interacting with cross\-functional team engineers, architects, internal and vendor partners to evangelize and provide NextGEN network technology solutions to;

* Maximize the business value from Sanofi’s Digital Technology and Solutions investments.

	+ Automate complex multi\-vendor network environments across LAN, WAN, data center, SD\-WAN, and cloud.

	+ Develop API\-driven workflows and automation services.

	+ Evaluate opportunities for predictive analytics and intelligent network operations.

	+ Drive Automation \& Continuous improvement of Network platform solutioning, specification \& design, systems integration, platform lifecycle management, standards, and documentation.
	+ Drive process improvements that integrate automation and monitor effectiveness to improve efficiency \& service delivery.

 **About you:**

	+ An enthusiasm for staying up to date with the very latest updates with Network technology solutions.
	+ Ability to translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
	+ Strong software engineering mindset.
	+ Ability to influence engineering decisions.
	+ Strong written and verbal communication.
	+ Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
	+ Strong focus on operational excellence, reliability, security, and scalability.
* **Technical Skills**
* + **7\+ years of experience in network engineering**, with substantial experience in network automation.
	+ Strong enterprise networking background with expertise in routing, switching, WAN, SD\-WAN, and network security.
	+ Advanced **Python** programming experience.
	+ Strong hands\-on experience with **Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, Git, JSON, and YAML**.
	+ Experience developing production\-grade automation frameworks.
	+ Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices.
	+ Experience working with multi\-vendor network environments.
	+ Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code and configuration management.
	+ Networking in cloud computing experience (Azure, AWS, \& GCP)
	+ Familiarity and understanding of tunnelling protocols (vxLAN, GRE, IPSec)
	+ Working knowledge of DNS, Tacacs, Radius, DHCP, NetFlow, Syslog, etc.
	+ Exposure to SCADA modelled Network and concepts.
	+ Vendor (technical) management experience
	+ Occasional work outside business hours

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (Modern C++)
description:
**Senior Embedded Software Engineer (Modern C\+\+)**

**Location:** Hyderabad

**Department:** Engineering

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Position Overview** We are seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize high\-performance, secure firmware for our next\-generation hardware platforms. In this role, you will bridge the gap between low\-level hardware interactions, high\-level architectural design, and strict payment industry compliance.

Our engineering culture prioritizes safety, deterministic execution, ultra\-low latency, and transactional security. You will leverage modern C\+\+17 to build robust, zero\-overhead abstractions—completely eliminating legacy, error\-prone C patterns. You will own the end\-to\-end automation pipeline, ensuring software quality via cross\-compilation, advanced **ISTO**\-compliant hardware tracing, and secure **EMV** transaction workflows.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **EMV Protocol Implementation \& Compliance:** Design, optimize, and maintain EMV Contact (L1/L2\) and Contactless kernels. Implement highly secure, zero\-allocation APDU parsing pipelines and cryptographic wrappers that comply with strict payment network certifications.
* **Modern Driver Architecture:** Design and maintain peripheral drivers (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, DMA, NFC/RFID interfaces) utilizing C\+\+17 compile\-time design patterns (if constexpr, template polymorphism) to eliminate runtime overhead.
* **Advanced Trace \& Debugging (ISTO):** Leverage **ISTO** standards (e.g., IEEE\-ISTO Nexus 5001 Global Embedded Processor Debug Interface) for non\-intrusive trace, performance analysis, and root\-cause debugging of bare\-metal applications without impacting timing behavior.
* **Resource \& Memory Management:** Author deterministic, zero\-heap applications using custom allocators, placement new, and RAII wrappers to guarantee zero memory leaks and block\-free execution during time\-critical payment processing.
* **Firmware Virtualization \& Simulation:** Build and manage cross\-compilation toolchains targeting custom architectures. Set up and run automated test suites inside QEMU / Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) environments for EMV regression testing.
* **Sanitizer Instrumentation:** Instrument code and debug complex runtime issues using memory, thread, and undefined behavior sanitizers (ASan, TSan, UBSan) integrated directly into CI/CD pipelines.

**Required Technical Skills \& Competencies** To be successful in this role, you must be able to demonstrate deep expertise in the following areas during our technical assessment:

**1\. EMV \& Secure Systems Engineering**

* Demonstrated experience developing embedded software compliant with **EMVCo** specifications, ISO 7816, or ISO 14443 standards.
* Understanding of secure elements, payment cryptography (RSA, DES/3DES, AES), and side\-channel attack mitigation in a bare\-metal environment.

**2\. Advanced C\+\+17 Concepts**

* Deep understanding of non\-owning memory types (std::string\_view) and explicit error\-handling models without heap usage (std::optional, std::variant) to handle complex payment state machines safely.
* Expert utilization of type\-safe hardware mapping tools (std::byte) and strict safety enforcements (\[\[nodiscard]]).

**3\. Low\-Level Memory \& Concurrency Management**

* Strong knowledge of disabling non\-deterministic language features (e.g., building with \-fno\-exceptions and \-fno\-rtti) while preserving architectural safety.
* Mastery of thread synchronization using lightweight, lock\-free hardware atomics (std::atomic) over heavy mutexes to prevent priority inversions during synchronous I/O operations.

**4\. Simulation, DevOps, and Tooling**

* Hands\-on experience interpreting complex stack traces, utilizing **ISTO** tracing protocols, and debugging target\-specific binaries running under emulators (QEMU).
* Experience writing and optimizing automated test configurations for CI/CD environments (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins).

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience developing production\-grade firmware for bare\-metal systems or RTOS environments (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr).
* Expert\-level proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17 or later) and modern CMake build systems using VSCode / Kiro IDE.
* Strong familiarity with ARM Cortex\-M, RISC\-V, or similar modern microprocessor architectures, specifically those featuring advanced secure enclaves/TrustZone.

Pay: ₹1,077,297\.92 \- ₹3,580,133\.99 per year

* Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring software engineering teams.
* Strong client\-facing and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs, development plans, and actionable execution strategies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, organizational, and time\-management skills.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced Agile development environment.


Advantages
  
In addition to the core requirements, the following skills and experience would be advantageous:
  
  

* Knowledge and experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and cloud infrastructure/services.
* Experience with cloud\-native application development and architecture.
* Exposure to modern DevOps practices and tooling.
* Experience working with enterprise\-scale middleware, application servers, and database technologies.
* Experience with AI\-assisted software development and adoption of AI engineering practices.
* Experience working directly with global clients and distributed engineering teams.

Required technical skills  

Salesforce platform  

* Strong hands\-on experience with Apex, Triggers, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Objects, Validation Rules and Salesforce security concepts.


Declarative and programmatic development  

* Ability to select the right Salesforce approach across configuration, Flow and code, while producing maintainable, testable and scalable solutions.

* DevOps and engineering
* Git or similar version control
* CI/CD and release management for Salesforce
* Apex unit testing, test automation and quality gates
* Salesforce deployment and environment management
* Agile / SCRUM delivery and production support


Experience  

Essential  

* 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience across declarative and programmatic delivery.
* Strong experience with Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Flows and Salesforce platform development best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud; Experience Cloud exposure is desirable.
* Experience designing and delivering robust, scalable Salesforce solutions in enterprise environments.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with other enterprise applications and working with APIs / integration patterns.
* Experience using Git or similar source\-control tooling and working within CI/CD and controlled release processes.
* Experience working in Agile/SCRUM teams, including refinement, estimation, code review, testing and defect resolution.
* Strong debugging, analytical and problem\-solving capability, with attention to detail and ability to work independently.


Good to have  

* Salesforce Industries / Vlocity experience, including OmniScripts, EPC / Product Catalog and Integration Procedures.
* Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I / II, Platform App Builder and/or relevant Salesforce Industries credentials.
* Experience with enterprise integration technologies, REST APIs, middleware and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with Salesforce Energy \& Utilities Cloud or energy / utilities business processes.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling and DevOps practices for Salesforce, including automated validation and deployment pipelines.
* Experience mentoring developers, leading technical initiatives or contributing to platform standards and architecture discussions.
* Experience supporting high\-volume, highly available enterprise Salesforce platforms.


Behavioural competencies  

* Ownership from design through production support and continuous improvement.
* Strong collaboration across engineering, architecture, product and business teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Continuous\-learning and continuous\-improvement mindset.
* Pragmatic decision\-making focused on customer and business outcomes.
* Commitment to quality, security, reliability and Salesforce engineering best practices.

 **Job Title:**

 **HIH \- Software Engineering Advisor – SAP Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP) Technical Product Owner**

 **Position Overview**

  

The SAP Procure\-to\-Pay Technical Product Owner is accountable for the vision, strategy, roadmap, backlog, and measurable value of SAP S/4HANA Procure\-to\-Pay capabilities. This role connects procurement and finance stakeholders with architecture, engineering, integration, data, security, and support teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and user\-centered solutions.

  

**Job Overview:**


The Product Owner translates business outcomes into prioritized epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans; makes timely scope and priority decisions; and ensures solutions align with enterprise architecture, Clean Core principles, global process standards, and the broader SAP transformation roadmap. The role retains sufficient functional and technical depth to guide solution design across SAP MM/PTP, EDI/IDoc, EWM, Finance\-to\-Manage, Order\-to\-Cash, Learn\-to\-Order, master data, SAP Fiori, BTP, and external supplier platforms.

 **Responsibilities:**

 **Product Strategy, Roadmap \& Agile Delivery**

  

* Define and communicate the product vision, goals, roadmap, and outcome\-based priorities for SAP S/4HANA PTP capabilities.
* Own and continuously refine the product backlog, including epics, features, user stories, technical enablers, defects, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and nonfunctional requirements.
* Prioritize work using business value, user impact, risk reduction, regulatory needs, architectural dependencies, operational stability, cost, and delivery capacity.
* Partner with business leaders, product management, architects, engineering teams, Scrum Masters, and delivery partners to establish release objectives and executable plans.
* Lead discovery, requirements workshops, process reviews, solution option analysis, and decomposition of business needs into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Participate actively in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily collaboration, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and program increment activities as applicable.
* Provide clear and timely decisions on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and acceptance; validate completed work against agreed acceptance criteria and product outcomes.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment through transparent roadmap, backlog, dependency, risk, release, and value\-delivery reporting.

 **SAP Solution \& Technical Ownership**

  

* Guide end\-to\-end solution design across purchase requisitions, purchase orders, sourcing, contracts, service procurement, inventory movements, Logistics Invoice Verification, three\-way matching, GR/IR, account determination, and supplier master data.
* Ensure product decisions align with SAP S/4HANA standards, enterprise architecture, Clean Core principles, reusable integration patterns, security, audit controls, and supportability expectations.
* Partner with solution and technical architects to evaluate configuration, extension, integration, workflow, reporting, data, automation, and custom\-development options.
* Own functional intent and delivery outcomes for interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, APIs, OData services, CDS views, batch jobs, and related WRICEF objects.
* Drive cross\-functional integration with SAP EWM, FTM/FI\-CO, OTC/SD, LTO or eCommerce, master data, analytics, security, quality, external suppliers, logistics providers, and financial institutions.
* Ensure robust EDI, IDoc, API, file, and middleware capabilities, including mapping, routing, monitoring, reconciliation, exception handling, reprocessing, and trading\-partner onboarding.
* Balance new capability delivery with technical debt reduction, reliability, performance, compliance, lifecycle management, and production support needs.

 **User Experience, Release \& Value Management**

  

* Champion intuitive, role\-based SAP Fiori experiences across requisitioning, approvals, purchasing, goods receipt, supplier invoicing, exception management, and procurement analytics.
* Use stakeholder feedback, process data, support trends, and user research to identify pain points and prioritize improvements.
* Define release readiness and acceptance expectations across testing, security, data, integration, controls, training, cutover, communications, deployment, and support transition.
* Coordinate system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, cutover validation, hypercare, and post\-production stabilization.
* Define product measures and monitor outcomes such as adoption, cycle time, automation, straight\-through processing, supplier acknowledgment, receipt and invoice exceptions, blocked invoices, GR/IR aging, interface reliability, and user satisfaction.
* Inspect delivery results and operational performance, then adjust the roadmap and backlog to improve business value and product health.
* Support training, change management, release communications, user documentation, and adoption plans for global stakeholders.

 **Stakeholder \& Operational Leadership**

* Serve as the primary product decision\-maker and trusted partner for procurement, finance, supply chain, operations, technology, and delivery stakeholders.
* Facilitate decisions across competing priorities, clarify tradeoffs, manage expectations, and escalate risks or impediments when necessary.
* Lead production issue prioritization, defect triage, root\-cause follow\-through, service restoration decisions, and continuous\-improvement planning.
* Coordinate internal teams, external vendors, consultants, and managed\-service partners while retaining accountability for product outcomes.
* Promote product thinking, Agile practices, knowledge transfer, transparency, and a culture of ownership across global delivery and support teams.

 **Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 11 or more years of SAP PTP/MM functional configuration and delivery experience, including at least one full SAP S/4HANA implementation.
* Advanced experience with purchasing, source determination, inventory management, Logistics Invoice Verification, three\-way matching, GR/IR, account determination, supplier master data, and procurement controls.
* Strong hands\-on experience with EDI and IDoc design, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, reprocessing, and trading\-partner onboarding in a high\-volume SAP environment.
* Demonstrated experience integrating PTP with SAP EWM, FTM/FI\-CO, OTC/SD, LTO or eCommerce capabilities, master data, and external supplier systems.
* Experience creating functional specifications and leading delivery for interfaces, enhancements, APIs, workflows, reports, forms, and related WRICEF objects.
* Experience configuring, testing, supporting, and driving adoption of SAP Fiori applications, launchpad content, workflows, role\-based access, and embedded analytics.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end\-to\-end testing, defect resolution, cutover, hypercare, production support, and continuous improvement across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, documentation, stakeholder\-management, and supplier\-facing communication skills.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, wholesale distribution, healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated and high\-volume industry.
* Experience with SAP Integration Suite/CPI, PI/PO, BTP, APIs, OData services, CDS views, ALE, middleware monitoring, AS2, SFTP, or supplier\-network integrations.
* Knowledge of common procurement and logistics EDI transactions, including purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory activity, remittance, and functional acknowledgments.
* Experience with decentralized or embedded SAP EWM integration, stock transport orders, intercompany procurement, third\-party procurement, drop shipping, returns, and complex warehouse receiving scenarios.
* Experience with SAP Activate, Solution Manager, Cloud ALM, Jira, Confluence, Agile delivery, and global\-template deployment.
* SAP certification in S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement, Materials Management, Fiori, or a related discipline.

 **Core Competencies**

**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.  In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Job Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Android Software Engineer who possesses in\-depth knowledge of the Android ecosystem, a passion for security\-first development, and a strong product commitment. In this role, you will be a key player in designing, developing, and securing new features for our primary Android mobile products.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Technical Leadership: Drive the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of our core Android solutions, ensuring high performance, quality, and responsiveness.
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Oversee the development lifecycle from prototyping and implementation to testing, delivery, and ongoing maintenance.
* Security \& Best Practices: Define and evangelize development best practices with a strict focus on code robustness, mobile security, scalability, and performance.
* Collaboration \& Alignment: Work closely with Product Management, Sales, UX designers, and backend engineering teams to align on product roadmaps and backend API design.
* Customer \& Field Support: Interface with Support and field teams to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer escalations in large\-scale enterprise deployments.
* Mentorship: Lead brainstorming and design sessions, providing ongoing technical direction and code reviews for teammates across multiple global sites.
* Innovation: Stay ahead of the curve regarding evolving mobile technologies, Android OS updates, and relevant open\-source libraries.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with 3\+ years dedicated to the Android platform and at least 2 years in a technical leadership or lead role.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java, alongside a deep understanding of core Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
* Deep understanding of modern Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, MVP) and UI patterns (including Material Design).
* Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and asynchronous programming concepts.
* Experience with Android testing frameworks (Espresso, JUnit) and a solid understanding of Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Proven knowledge of code signing and distributing applications through the Google Play Store, as well as managing dependencies via Maven/Gradle.
* Solid understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts, including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, and token\-based authentication.
* Familiarity with user directory concepts like Active Directory, user groups, authentication/authorization mechanisms, and security policies.
* Understanding of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), PKI, certificate security, encryption, and secure data storage on mobile devices.
* Basic understanding or experience with cloud platforms, preferably Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS).
* Understanding of no\-schema (NoSQL) databases and local mobile data persistence.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Basic understanding of iOS development (Swift, Objective\-C, XCTest) is a strong plus to help collaborate on cross\-platform mobile initiatives.
* Working experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Mobile Application Management (MAM) policies.
* Experience or interest in full\-stack web development, Windows programming, or kernel\-mode development.
* Exposure to global security compliance and privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX, PII, and PHI data handling).
* Experience working in a fast\-paced Agile/Scrum environment across geographically distributed teams.


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

**Desirable:**

 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. title: SB-1501-Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
----------------


We are looking for a **Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead** with 7–10 years of strong hands\-on development experience and proven expertise in **technical architecture, application security, Azure, code quality, and team leadership**.
The role will be responsible for developing and modernizing enterprise\-grade .NET applications, designing scalable and secure technical solutions, reviewing and vetting code developed by other resources, and ensuring adherence to established architectural and security standards.
The candidate will work extensively on **authentication and credential security, cryptography, Azure Key Vault, API security, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, observability, performance, and legacy .NET application modernization**.
The role also requires the ability to lead developers technically, identify implementation risks, make architecture\-level decisions, and actively adopt **AI\-driven and specification\-driven development practices** to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Development \& Technical Architecture**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using **C\#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, .NET Framework and related Microsoft technologies**.
* Analyze existing applications and understand legacy architecture, dependencies, business flows, and technical constraints before implementing changes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, secure, and high\-performing application architectures.
* Define technical approaches, application components, integrations, APIs, data flows, and security mechanisms.
* Participate in architecture discussions and prepare technical design solutions for complex requirements.
* Ensure implementations follow established architectural patterns, coding standards, SOLID principles, and secure development practices.
* Identify technical debt, architectural risks, performance bottlenecks, and security weaknesses and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Work closely with Azure/DevOps resources to ensure application architecture aligns with infrastructure and deployment architecture.

### **Application Security \& Authentication**

* Implement and review secure authentication, authorization, password management, password reset, password history, and session\-management flows.
* Implement **bcrypt/Argon2id password hashing** and lazy re\-hashing/migration strategies for existing accounts.
* Implement secure random salt generation and eliminate static or hardcoded salts.
* Secure sensitive credentials and application secrets through appropriate key and secret management mechanisms.
* Implement and review **RSA, AES/symmetric encryption, hashing, encryption/decryption, key rotation, and secure key\-management practices**.
* Implement secure migration and re\-encryption of existing sensitive database values.
* Integrate applications with **Azure Key Vault** for RSA keys, symmetric keys, secrets, and tokenized credentials.
* Review and secure authentication cookies, including **Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite** attributes.
* Implement API security controls including authentication protection and **rate limiting for login, password\-reset, and related endpoints**.
* Ensure sensitive information is not exposed through APIs, logs, configuration files, resource files, or repositories.
* Apply **OWASP secure coding principles** and security best practices throughout development.

### **Code Review \& Technical Governance**

* Act as the primary technical reviewer for code delivered by other developers.
* Perform detailed **code reviews and architecture reviews** across backend components.
* Vet implementations for correctness, security, scalability, maintainability, performance, and architectural compliance.
* Identify security vulnerabilities, poor coding practices, technical debt, and architectural deviations.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, branching practices, and development guidelines.
* Review and validate database changes, API contracts, authentication implementations, encryption mechanisms, and third\-party integrations.
* Guide junior and mid\-level developers on technical implementation and troubleshooting.
* Ensure Critical/High findings from **SonarQube and vulnerability scans** are appropriately addressed.

### **Azure, DevSecOps \& Reliability**

* Work with **Azure Key Vault, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Azure monitoring, Application Insights, and related Azure services**.
* Ensure secure configuration and deployment practices across environments.
* Support removal of hardcoded secrets/keys from application resources and configuration.
* Implement appropriate retry, timeout, error\-handling, and dependency\-failure strategies.
* Contribute to resilience and redundancy considerations for security\-sensitive components.
* Support repository security, Git history cleanup, secret scanning, and .gitignore protection.
* Implement **correlation IDs, structured logging, security\-event logging, monitoring, and observability** across modified flows.
* Support dead\-letter/error handling for applicable asynchronous operations.
* Participate in vulnerability scanning, static code analysis, remediation, and security verification.

### **Testing \& Quality**

* Develop and maintain high\-quality, testable backend code.
* Write and review **unit and integration tests** for authentication, credential, API, and security\-sensitive flows.
* Support performance testing of login and authentication flows following credential\-storage changes.
* Work closely with QA to identify and resolve defects and improve test coverage.
* Review regression results and ensure all affected authentication and security flows are validated.
* Ensure implementation evidence, test results, scan results, and remediation details are properly documented in **Azure DevOps**.

### **Team Leadership \& Delivery**

* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction to developers working on the project.
* Break down complex technical requirements into appropriate implementation approaches.
* Mentor developers and support technical problem\-solving.
* Review estimates and technical feasibility of proposed solutions.
* Identify technical risks and dependencies early and communicate them to the Engineering/Delivery team.
* Coordinate with frontend, QA, DevOps, and project management teams to ensure smooth delivery.
* Take ownership of technical quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed architecture, security, and coding standards.
* Participate in sprint planning, technical discussions, reviews, retrospectives, and client\-facing technical discussions where required.

### **AI\-Driven Development**

* Actively use **AI\-assisted development tools** to improve development speed, code quality, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Work with tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI\-powered engineering tools**.
* Apply AI\-assisted and specification\-driven development practices across requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, code review, testing, and documentation.
* Use AI tools responsibly for code generation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, debugging, and code analysis while maintaining engineering review and security controls.
* Evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, architectural compliance, performance, and maintainability before integration.
* Stay current with emerging AI development practices and contribute to adoption of AI\-enabled engineering workflows within the team.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

**Domain** **Skills \& Technologies** **Must / Preferred**  

Backend Development C\#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, .NET Framework 4\.x, REST APIs **Must**  


Architecture Enterprise application architecture, scalable architecture, SOLID, design patterns, clean architecture, technical design **Must**

* Experience applying AI across the SDLC, including requirements, architecture, development, testing, code review, and documentation.
* Experience working with international clients and enterprise delivery environments.

* Strong experience in enterprise application development and technical architecture.
* Prior experience in a **Senior Developer / Technical Lead / Architect\-level role** preferred.
* Azure certifications such as **AZ\-204, AZ\-305, or relevant security certifications** are preferred but not mandatory.

**Soft Skills \& Cultural Fit**

We are looking forward to hire Power BI Professionals in the following areas :
  
  

**Position:** Senior Software Engineer – Power BI / Microsoft Fabric
  
**Experience:** 5\+ Years
  
**Location:** Hyderabad
  
**Company:** Yash Technologies
  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred
  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time
  
  

Educational Qualification
  
BE / B.Tech in any engineering discipline.
  
Candidates from any engineering stream are eligible, provided they meet the required technical skill set and experience criteria.
  
  

Role Overview
  
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer – Power BI / Microsoft Fabric with 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Power BI development, SQL, semantic modeling, Microsoft Fabric, data storytelling, and CI/CD implementation.
  
  

The candidate should be capable of working across the complete BI development lifecycle, including requirement understanding, data modeling, semantic model design, Power BI development, SQL optimization, dashboard storytelling, CI/CD implementation, deployment, and production support.
  
  

Required Technical Skills
  
1\. Power BI Development – Mandatory
  
5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Power BI development.
  
Strong experience developing enterprise\-grade Power BI reports and dashboards.
  
Excellent knowledge of Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.
  
Strong expertise in DAX and Power Query/M.
  
Ableity to build Paginated Reports by using Power BI Report Builder
  
Experience with calculated measures, calculated columns, and time intelligence.
  
Strong understanding of Power BI performance optimization.
  
Experience with Import, DirectQuery, and Direct Lake connectivity modes.
  
Experience with Power BI workspaces, gateways, refreshes, and deployments.
  
Knowledge of Row\-Level Security (RLS) and security implementation.
  
  

2\. Data Storytelling \& Dashboard Design – Mandatory
  
Strong data storytelling and visualization skills.
  
Ability to convert business requirements and complex datasets into meaningful insights.
  
Strong dashboard design and visualization capabilities.
  
Understanding of KPI design, visual hierarchy, drill\-through, drill\-down, tooltips, navigation, and interactive reporting.
  
Ability to design dashboards for business users, management, and executive stakeholders.
  
Strong focus on business outcomes rather than simply creating visual reports.
  
  

3\. Semantic Model \& Data Modeling – Mandatory
  
Strong experience designing Power BI Semantic Models / Microsoft Semantic Models.
  
Ability to design scalable, reusable, and high\-performance semantic models.
  
Strong knowledge of Star Schema and dimensional modeling.
  
Experience with relationships, cardinality, hierarchies, perspectives, measures, and calculation logic.
  
Good understanding of filter context and row context.
  
Experience with RLS / OLS.
  
Ability to create reusable semantic models supporting multiple reports and business use cases.
  
Experience optimizing semantic models for performance and scalability.
  
  

4\. Microsoft Fabric /Azure – Mandatory / Strong
  
Hands\-on experience with the Microsoft Fabric environment.
  
Good understanding of OneLake.
  
Fabric Lakehouse
  
Fabric Warehouse
  
Fabric Data Factory / Data Pipelines
  
Fabric Semantic Models
  
Power BI integration
  
Direct Lake
  
Understanding of Fabric workspace architecture, security, governance, and deployment.
  
Ability to develop end\-to\-end analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
  
  

5\. SQL – Mandatory / Expert
  
Excellent hands\-on experience with SQL.
  
Strong experience developing and optimizing Stored Procedures.
  
Strong expertise in complex SQL queries and Joins.
  
Experience with CTEs, subqueries, views, temporary tables, aggregations, and window functions.
  
Strong experience in SQL query optimization and performance tuning.
  
Ability to analyze execution plans and identify performance bottlenecks.
  
Experience working with large\-volume datasets.
  
  

6\. CI/CD \& DevOps – Mandatory
  
Strong experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for Power BI and Microsoft Fabric solutions.
  
Hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps and Git.
  
Experience with source control, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
  
  

**Experience implementing deployments across:**  

Development
  
QA
  
UAT
  
Production
  
Experience with Power BI Deployment Pipelines.
  
Experience implementing CI/CD for Power BI reports, semantic models, datasets, and Fabric artifacts.
  
Experience configuring Azure DevOps pipelines for automated deployments.
  
Understanding of environment\-specific configurations, parameters, and deployment variables.
  
Experience supporting production releases, release validation, and rollback processes.
  
Knowledge of Power BI/Fabric REST APIs and deployment automation is an advantage.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions.
  
Design scalable and reusable Microsoft Semantic Models.
  
Develop advanced DAX measures and optimize Power BI performance.
  
Create dashboards with strong data storytelling and business\-focused visualization.
  
Develop complex SQL queries and stored procedures.
  
Perform SQL query optimization and performance tuning.
  
Design and implement analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
  
Implement RLS/OLS and appropriate security controls.

Automate deployments across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production environments.
  
Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, architects, QA, and other technical teams.
  
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and follow SDLC best practices.
  
Troubleshoot production issues and perform root\-cause analysis.
  
  

Monitor capacity utilization, troubleshoot pipeline and report failures, perform root cause analysis
  
and drive corrective actions to ensure operational efficiency, system reliability, and accurate report

title: Appian Automation Developer
description:
##### **Project description**

We are looking for 5\+ years of experienced and enthusiastic Appian Automation Developers to be part of our growing Appian Digital Automation team. You will have the opportunity to work with a reputed global clientele of ours on change and digital transformation projects and be part of Appian CoE for our clients.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Appian application development, workflow automation, process orchestration, integrations, and digital transformation initiatives.

Collaborate with business partners to understand their needs and challenges, gathering requirements and translate them into Appian\-based automation solutions.


Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and enhance Appian based automation solutions based on prioritized stakeholder requirements ensuring highest quality and performance.


Automate manual and repetitive tasks to improve operational efficiency.


Implement intelligent automation capabilities utilizing Appian AI features.


Perform production verification testing of the code you have created during the production release cycle.


Utilize latest Appian features to automate end\-to\-end processes in a modern way.


Lead various aspects of solution delivery in partnership with internal teams and external partners.


Proactively work with team members and independently to assess and explore new technologies, conduct proof of concepts to test these and share with wider team within the Appian Practice.


Proactively identify and communicate options and solution recommendations to business and IT leaders with benefits and drawbacks.


Guide teams to build solutions according to industry standards, specifications and best practices.


Take initiative to identify and communicate issues, risks, and progress to both business and IT stakeholders, presenting available options and recommend next steps


Collaborate with application support teams throughout development, deployment, and support phases.


Continuously learn and seek opportunities to enhance technical skills and expand the business knowledge in Luxoft Appian and Automation Practice.


Assist in talent selection and hiring activities.


##### **Skills**


Must have


Have 7\+ years of software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in following technologies: Appian, Scripting, REST API services, Java and JavaScript.


Possess 5\+ Years of experience in Appian and completed implementation for at least 3 Appian projects.


Exhibit expertise in integrations utilizing Web API, Integrations, with the capability to tailor these functionalities to suit external system requirements.


Showcase a robust grasp of database principles, coupled with practical experience in Stored Procs, MySQL or SQL Server.


Demonstrate experience in Appian Process Models, Rules \& Expressions, Data Management including Complex Data Types, XSDs, SQL, Inter Process Communication, RBAC, and Process Reporting on Appian 20\.X and above.


Possess Appian Certification as per your experience level.


Embrace an agile mindset and have a level of familiarization with Agile methodologies along with having a knack for crafting solutions that facilitate business process automation.


Offer a blend of technical prowess, strong business acumen, leadership abilities, and a track record of effective knowledge transfer.


Possess a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field from an accredited university or college.


Nice to have


Rest API

title: Agentic AI Developer
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role:**

Azurity is seeking an Agentic AI Developer to design, build, and deploy AI agents and multi\-step autonomous workflows that integrate with internal systems and business processes.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Design and build AI agents that use large language models to plan, reason, and execute multi\-step tasks, including data retrieval, document generation, and cross\-system workflows
* Integrate agents with internal and third\-party systems via APIs, MCP servers, and other tool\-calling frameworks
* Build and maintain orchestration layers for multi\-agent workflows, including error handling, retries, and human\-in\-the\-lead checkpoints


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Three or more years of professional software development experience, including at least one year working directly with large language models or agentic AI systems
* Strong proficiency in Python or a similar language, with experience using large language model APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable providers
* Hands\-on experience building tool\-calling or function\-calling agents, including designing tool schemas and managing multi\-turn reasoning
* Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks and concepts (ReAct, planning/reflection loops, multi\-agent coordination)
* Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and embedding models
* Solid understanding of API design, integration patterns, and asynchronous systems
* Experience implementing evaluation, observability, and safety guardrails for AI systems in production
* Comfort working in a regulated industry, with attention to data privacy, security, and compliance requirements
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate business problems into technical solutions and explain AI system behavior to non\-technical stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industries
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool\-integration standards
* Experience with enterprise systems commonly used in pharmaceutical environments, such as Veeva, Salesforce, ERP, or IT service management platforms
* Background in prompt engineering and fine\-tuning/evaluation of LLMs
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps practices.

  

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Corp Eng
description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures/algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

  

At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.
